.. change::
    :tags: feature, sqlite
    :tickets: 1904

    Added a new ``sqlite_foreign_keys`` option to
    :meth:`.EnvironmentContext.configure` to control SQLite foreign key
    enforcement during an online migration run.  With
    ``sqlite_foreign_keys="deferred"``, Alembic switches
    ``PRAGMA foreign_keys`` off for the duration of the run and instead runs
    ``PRAGMA foreign_key_check`` once per migration (or once for the whole
    run when an externally opened transaction is in use), allowing a
    migration that builds two mutually referencing tables to complete
    before referential integrity is verified.  A failed check raises a
    :class:`.CommandError` naming the revision responsible together with
    every violating row, and the connection's original pragma setting is
    restored when the run finishes, including after an error.  The new
    ``"immediate"`` mode switches enforcement on for the run and likewise
    restores the original setting, while the default ``"manual"`` mode
    leaves the pragma untouched.
